coverage_claim.regret_denominator: all label-complete intent-eligible contracts on every included minute, including RLAC WAIT minutes
coverage_claim.regret_excluded: label-incomplete rows and minutes with zero intent-eligible contracts only
coverage_claim.wait_denominator: all label-complete governed flat minutes in the RLAC population

loss_weight.application: add these fixed weighted losses to the renormalized six-family primary loss
loss_weight.missing_target: mask only label-incomplete or RLAC-inapplicable targets; runtime composer output and model-selected actions are forbidden missingness reasons. If minimum calibration evidence later fails, the candidate is ineligible rather than silently continuing.

selected_contract_regret_heads.calibrated_upper_bound: min(1,raw_q90+qhat), where qhat is the finite-sample 0.90 one-sided conformal quantile of max(0,r-raw_q90) from the same frozen final model's disjoint calibration entries
selected_contract_regret_heads.realized_target: r(t,c)=U_label(t,c_star_regret)-U_label(t,c), where c_star_regret is the RLAC deterministic U_label argmax over the complete intent-eligible risk set. The exact target lies in [0,1], equals zero for c_star_regret, and is produced before any model head is fit.
selected_contract_regret_heads.rlac_wait_minutes: retained in both WAIT-head loss and full-population regret loss through c_star_regret_label; runtime WAIT decisions may not remove them or relabel them as zero regret
selected_contract_regret_heads.scope: one pair of outputs for every label-complete intent-eligible contract on every included governed flat minute, including RLAC WAIT minutes; runtime composer selections never control target membership

training_data_path: build causal model inputs from FT2-08 feature partitions
join physically separate FT2-04 labels using FT2-08 label_join_spec only inside the training process
build nested empirical CDFs from fit sessions only
run the frozen model-free one-pass RLAC over the complete label-eligible intent population to construct WAIT and per-contract regret targets before fitting any model head
predict the disjoint final-calibration sessions once
calibrate and hash WAIT and regret outputs
freeze calibrated head artifacts before the runtime entry composer is evaluated
strip every label and audit target from inference artifacts

wait_probability_head.calibration: isotonic calibration on predictions from the same final model over its disjoint calibration sessions
wait_probability_head.inputs: shared causal state plus permutation-invariant pooling of contract representations, causal action masks, and path-head forecasts; no realized labels
wait_probability_head.loss: masked_binary_cross_entropy over every label-complete governed flat minute in the RLAC population
wait_probability_head.runtime_derivation: the calibrated output itself; no implementation may substitute action rate or a post-hoc constant
wait_probability_head.scope: one output for every label-auditable governed flat minute with at least one time-t intent-eligible contract in the exact RLAC WAIT population; zero-intent-eligible and label-incomplete minutes are excluded and counted; runtime composer output and runtime model selection never control target membership
wait_probability_head.training_target: Import realized_label_audit_composer_spec.json:/targets/WAIT_head exactly: y_wait(t)=1 if WAIT_justified(t) else 0, where WAIT_justified means no exact contract passes the RLAC contract_pass conjunction of time-t intent eligibility, complete labels, every active realized guardrail, and realized fee-cleared upside. No scalar U_label threshold is defined or permitted. The target is constructed by the model-free one-pass RLAC before any model head is fit.

ensemble.aggregate_quantile: median across seed-specific same-model calibrated quantiles
ensemble.epistemic_scale: 1.4826 times median absolute deviation of seed-specific q50 forecasts

central_tendency_entry_gate_outputs.composer_role: positive-after-fee gate only; the existing calibrated-q10 favorable percentiles remain the unchanged rank statistics
central_tendency_entry_gate_outputs.ensemble: median across the three seed-specific conditional-mean forecasts before the disjoint-calibration lower-confidence correction
central_tendency_entry_gate_outputs.head_family: required fixed-weight gate-support companions to the existing upside family; they do not delete, replace, retune, or reweight any existing quantile head
central_tendency_entry_gate_outputs.loss: masked mean squared error on the unchanged full-window fee-adjusted labels
central_tendency_entry_gate_outputs.output: unbounded conditional arithmetic mean in each native fee-adjusted unit

full_window_training_filter: Continuous, bounded, count, and empirical-CDF targets for finite hN require the complete uncensored N-mark window; finite near-close censored values are excluded. Right-censored time-to-first-profit rows remain eligible only for the registered discrete-survival likelihood with their censoring indicator.

binary_probability.calibration: isotonic regression on predictions from the frozen final model over its disjoint calibration sessions; insufficient evidence blocks confidence-controlled behavior

bounded_continuous_quantile.calibration: same-final-model disjoint calibration defined in calibration_spec.json

continuous_quantile.calibration: same-final-model disjoint calibration defined in calibration_spec.json
continuous_quantile.monotonicity: parameterize q10 directly and each higher quantile as the prior quantile plus softplus(nonnegative_increment); post-hoc sorting is forbidden

count_distribution.point_forecast: smallest integer whose cumulative probability is at least 0.5

discrete_survival.calibration: same-final-model disjoint isotonic calibration of cumulative incidence at each registered horizon
discrete_survival.output: one-minute conditional hazard from minute 1 through causally available_minutes plus survival mass beyond that clock boundary

minute_offset_distribution.point_forecast: smallest minute offset whose cumulative probability is at least 0.5

inapplicable_target_rule: A family-horizon pair that FT2-04 does not define is absent, not zero-filled. Label validity controls supervised loss only and is never a composer input; runtime horizon availability is causal clock state from composer_spec.json.

loss_weight_family.auxiliary_weight: 0.25 times the mean primary-metric weight within that family; auxiliary losses do not enter composer ranking directly
loss_weight_family.dual_unit_weight: 1/2 dollars and 1/2 return for paired targets

target_firewall.action_head_target_producer: the frozen model-free one-pass realized_label_audit_composer_spec.json only
